```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Chunks call the live Iconify API, so they only run when asked to
# (the pkgdown workflow sets this variable).
live <- identical(Sys.getenv("ICONIFYR_LIVE_VIGNETTES"), "true")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = live)
library(iconifyr)
library(htmltools)
options(iconifyr.cache = FALSE)

icon_cell <- function(id, size = 40, ...) {
  tags$span(
    title = id,
    style = "display: inline-block; margin: 0 0.6em 0.4em 0;",
    iconify_html(id, size = size, ...)
  )
}

gallery <- function(spec) {
  sets <- iconify_sets()
  rows <- lapply(names(spec), function(p) {
    info <- sets[sets$prefix == p, ]
    tags$tr(
      tags$td(tags$strong(info$name), tags$br(), tags$code(p)),
      tags$td(info$license_spdx),
      tags$td(lapply(paste0(p, ":", spec[[p]]), icon_cell))
    )
  })
  tags$table(
    class = "table",
    tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Icon set"), tags$th("License"), tags$th("Icons"))),
    tags$tbody(rows)
  )
}
```

Iconify hosts 240+ icon sets behind one API. Every icon below was fetched live
with `iconify_html()`. Hover over an icon to see its id; pass it to
`iconify_get()` to get the SVG.

## Same idea, different sets

Seven sets, each with its own drawing style and license. Monotone icons take the
surrounding text color, so they follow light and dark themes.

```{r same-idea}
gallery(list(
  mdi = c("home", "rocket-launch", "chart-line", "github"),
  tabler = c("brand-github", "map-pin", "leaf", "bolt"),
  lucide = c("camera", "sun", "leaf", "map"),
  ph = c("airplane", "tree", "map-pin", "chart-bar"),
  bi = c("globe", "tree", "bicycle", "graph-up"),
  carbon = c("earth", "chart-line", "map", "tree"),
  `fa6-solid` = c("tree", "earth-americas", "chart-simple", "bicycle")
))
```

## Brand logos

```{r brands}
gallery(list(
  `fa6-brands` = c("r-project", "github", "python", "docker"),
  `simple-icons` = c("rstudioide", "quarto", "github", "posit"),
  logos = c("r-lang", "github-icon", "python", "docker-icon")
))
```

## Multicolor sets

`color` only recolors monotone icons. Emoji and flat-color sets keep their own
palette.

```{r multicolor}
gallery(list(
  twemoji = c("globe-showing-americas", "seedling", "bar-chart", "rocket"),
  `flat-color-icons` = c("globe", "combo-chart", "camera")
))
```

## Color, size, flip and rotate

One icon, many variations:

```{r variations}
id <- "mdi:rocket-launch"
tags$div(
  icon_cell(id, color = "#e63946"),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#2a9d8f"),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#457b9d", size = 64),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#f4a261", flip = "horizontal"),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#8d5fd3", rotate = 90),
  icon_cell(id, color = "#264653", rotate = 180, flip = "vertical")
)
```

```r
iconify_html("mdi:rocket-launch", color = "#f4a261", flip = "horizontal")
iconify_html("mdi:rocket-launch", color = "#8d5fd3", rotate = 90)
```

## Pick an icon from search results

```{r search}
hits <- iconify_search("rocket", prefixes = c("mdi", "tabler", "ph", "lucide"), limit = 32)
head(hits, 8)

tags$div(lapply(head(hits$id, 8), icon_cell, size = 36))
```

## Credits

Using an icon means following its set's license. `iconify_license()` returns
what you need for a credit line:

```{r credits}
sets_used <- c(
  "mdi", "tabler", "lucide", "ph", "bi", "carbon", "fa6-solid",
  "fa6-brands", "simple-icons", "logos", "twemoji", "flat-color-icons"
)
lic <- lapply(sets_used, iconify_license, quiet = TRUE)
data.frame(
  prefix = vapply(lic, `[[`, "", "prefix"),
  license = vapply(lic, `[[`, "", "license"),
  author = vapply(lic, `[[`, "", "author"),
  attribution = ifelse(vapply(lic, function(x) isTRUE(x$attribution_required), NA), "required", "-")
)
```
